claim: Demo changes never enter your saved cards.
sandbox: open /demo first; change and reset the sample; compare real IndexedDB before and after leaving demo

claim: Create, reorder, complete, duplicate, and delete audio repair cards.
sandbox: fresh /demo session; perform every card action and assert the resulting order, state, copy, and deletion

claim: Selected audio plays in the tab and is not uploaded or stored in a card.
sandbox: fresh /demo session; attach a generated WAV, inspect the blob URL, requests, demo storage, and reload state

claim: Timestamp labels open the selected audio at the saved moment.
sandbox: fresh /demo session with a generated WAV; add a 0:01 label and assert player time and focus

claim: FFmpeg command text requires different input and output paths and is never run by the app.
sandbox: fresh /demo session; reject an equal path, quote a hostile-looking path, show text, and observe no external request

claim: Export and import a validated version 1 Chain Cards JSON file.
sandbox: fresh /demo session; inspect a real download, reimport it, then reject malformed nested data without adding a card

claim: Saved real cards remain after refresh and tab close.
sandbox: start at /demo, enter real mode, change the starter, reload, close the tab, and open the same card in a new tab

claim: The demo and saved cards work offline after the first visit.
sandbox: dedicated fresh browser context; reload /demo offline, then save a real card and reload that card offline; close only that context

claim: The app has no accounts, analytics, ads, trackers, cookies, or third-party runtime scripts.
sandbox: dedicated fresh context; record the full /demo flow request log, cookies, account controls, and loaded scripts

claim: Chain Cards is free to use and released under the MIT License.
sandbox: start at /demo; open Terms, fetch the shipped license, and confirm there is no checkout or billing action

claim: Chain Cards records instructions but does not process audio or guarantee improvement.
sandbox: fresh /demo session; attach audio, create command text, assert the source remains attached and no processed download appears, then inspect Terms
